messages:
nina: Heads-up experiencing a shape parity bug in the Python SDK async embeddings helper used by the embeddings+rerank sample app. Single-input async responses sometimes get unwrapped into a flat vector.

sam: Can you paste a tiny repro and the failure?

nina: Repro (async):

```
res = await client.embeddings.create(model='embed-lite', input='one sentence')
print(type(res.data), len(res.data))
print(res.data[0])
```

Expected: res.data -> [list(float)]. Actual: occasionally res.data == [0.1,0.2,..] -> rerank treats floats as docs and crashes with TypeError. Repro ~30% locally under concurrency.

leo: Likely culprit: async normalizer has _maybe_unwrap_singletons used by response path. Sync path normalizes to list always.

nina: Filed issue: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/523  "async: singleton unwrapping breaks rerank shape".

sam: Proposed fix: always normalize inputs at callsite (wrap singletons) and never unwrap on output; update typing to List[List[float]] and sampleapp. Nonbreaking if handled carefully.

leo: I'll draft a small patch + unit tests that assert single vs multi shapes for sync and async. Also add integration test running sampleapp flow.

docs-bot: Added docs note: onboarding snippet `inputs = [inputs] if isinstance(inputs, str) else inputs`.

nina: Thanks everyone, leaving details in the issue and attaching flaky repro test.
